```{r}
#|echo: false
#|warning: false

#read in required packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(forcats)
library(scales)

mat_neo_data <- read_excel(here('data/MatNeoSIP.xlsx'), sheet = 'Data') |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename('stage_7_all' = 'stage_7',
         'quarter' = 'date') |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., 'x', 'stage_'), starts_with('x'))
```

```{r}
#functions

#1 aggregate
aggregate_int <- function(df, my_filter, intervention){
  
  #to quote variable 
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)
  
  df |> 
    filter(!!my_filter) |> 
    group_by(psc, 
             !!intervention
             ) |>
    summarise(n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(psc) |>
    mutate(total = sum(n),
           percentage = round((n/total)*100, 1)
           ) |>
    ungroup()
  
}

#2 make graph
visualise <- function(df, intervention){

  #to quote variable 
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)
  intervention_subtitle <- deparse(intervention)
  
  #custom palette of blues in reversed order 
  blues <- rev(scales::brewer_pal()(7)) 
  
  #fonts <- ()
  #crate a NULL parameter for subtitle
  
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = forcats::fct_rev(psc), #reverse alphabetical order
               y = percentage,
               fill = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) #reverse stage order
               )
           ) +
    geom_bar(stat = 'identity',
             position = 'stack',
             size = 11
             ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = blues) +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage), #rounding to no decimal places here
                                 '%') #so bars stack to 100 or as close as possible
                  ),
            colour = 'white',
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)
            ) +
    labs(title = 'Breakdown of stages of adoption across all PSCs',
         subtitle = str_to_title( #3 capitalise clean string into title
           str_replace_all( #2 replace _ with blank space
             str_remove(intervention_subtitle, '~'), #1 remove ~ added by deparse
             '_', ' ')
           )
         ) + 
    #guide_legend(reverse = T) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = 'bottom'
          )
}
```

# MatNeoSIP - Optimisation

## Maternity and Neonatal – Programme Overview

![](data/matneo_overview.PNG)

## title slide

```{r}
mat_neo_agg <- mat_neo_data |>
  filter(quarter == "2024/25 Q1") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = magnesium_sulphate:mews,
    names_to = "intervention",
    values_to = "stage"
  )

visualise(
  aggregate_int(
    mat_neo_agg,
    expr(!intervention %in% c(
      "mews", "newtt2",
      "volume_targeted_ventilation", # why has this been excluded?
      "caffeine" # ditto
    )),
    stage
  ),
  stage
)

```

```{r}
#deploy functions
visualise(aggregate_int(mat_neo_data, expr(quarter == '2024/25 Q1'), place_of_birth),
          place_of_birth)
```
